_what: Which rows an independent, blinded re-derivation actually witnessed.
_source: generated from independent, blinded re-derivations of the committed rows, wave by wave: a second implementer computed them from the specification prose alone, with each expected value stripped and each cross-row answer redacted, using no elliptic-curve library. Where a row needed an ML-KEM operation the sandbox could not perform, the KEM outputs were supplied as NIST-oracled values and only the composition beyond them was re-derived
_narrowing: The re-derivation witnessed an EIGHT-byte view tag. The shipped width is one byte (§1), narrowed when §2.4 made the announced stealthAddress comparison a MUST. No row was re-derived again for the new width and none needed to be: every value that moved is a strict PREFIX of the value already witnessed, the shared secrets those tags derive from are byte-identical, and the byte counts that moved are arithmetic on the width. The affected rows are V1-07, V2-10, V2-11, V3-08 and V3-08a; each carries the superseded eight-byte value in its `wrong` column, so the prefix relation is checkable from the fixtures alone.
